## Services & Pricing (USD)
### Lash Extensions (Extensão de Cílios)
- **Eyelash Extension Set**: Custom lash extensions tailored to eye anatomy and preferences (natural to bold volume, brown or black shades). Set: $190 | 2-week Fill: $90 | 3-week Fill: $130
- **Fox Eyes**: Specialty curl extensions designed for an elongated, lifted fox-eye effect. Set: $195 | 2-week Fill: $95 | 3-week Fill: $130
- **Half Fox**: Outer-half lash extensions for an elongated look (consultation recommended). Set: $150 | 2-week Fill: $80 | 3-week Fill: $100
- **Diamond**: High-volume technique with up to 30-day durability and no maintenance fills required. Price: $225
- **Lower Eyelash Extension**: Enhances bottom lashes for a balanced, open gaze. Set: $60 | Fill: $45
- **Consultation & Allergy Test (Consulta e teste de alergia)**: Full evaluation and patch test for sensitive eyes. Price: $10
- **Removal (Remoção)**: Gentle lash extension removal. Price: $20

### Lash Lift & Brow Lamination
- **Lash Lift**: Enhances natural lash curl with a mascara effect, no extensions needed. Price: $130
- **Brow Lamination**: Aligns and smooths brow hairs for fuller, polished, natural-looking brows. Price: $130

### Eyebrows (Sobrancelhas)
- **Eyebrow Design (Wax)**: Custom brow mapping and shaping with wax. Design: $35 | Design + Tinting: $45
- **Eyebrow Design (Tweezers)**: Precise, delicate brow shaping with tweezers. Design: $40 | Design + Tint: $50

### Facial Waxing (Wax)
- **Full Face (Wax)**: Complete facial waxing. Price: $30
- **Upper Lip (Wax)**: Quick upper lip waxing. Price: $8

## Cancellation & Booking Policies
- **Vagaro Online Booking Policy**: At least 24 hours advance notice required for cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations (<24h) or no-shows incur a 50% fee. Arrivals >10 minutes late may result in shortened service or rescheduling with a fee.
- **WhatsApp Booking Policy**: At least 12 hours advance notice required for cancellations or changes. Late cancellations (<12h) or no-shows incur a 50% fee. 10-minute grace period; clients are asked to arrive 5 minutes early.
- **Safety & Responsibility**: Individual results and retention vary from person to person. Evaluation and allergy testing are part of the care process.
